name: memcairn
description: Long-term memory shared by all your Claude instances, on your own Memcairn server. Adds the memory tools and a short memory overview at session start. Changes nothing else; `memcairn setup` offers the optional extras.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Base URL of your Memcairn server, without /mcp (for example https://memory.example.com).

token.title: Token
token.description: Client token (memcairn token add <name> on the server). Stored in the system keychain. Easier, without the plugin: memcairn pair.
